skill.summary: IMA 个人笔记服务 API skill，用于管理用户的 IMA 笔记。支持搜索笔记、浏览笔记本、获取笔记内容、新建笔记和追加内容。 当用户提到笔记、备忘录、记事、知识库，或者想要查找、阅读、创建、编辑笔记内容时，使用此 skill。 即使用户没有明确说"笔记"，只要意图涉及个人文档的存取（如"帮我记一下"、"我...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ima-note skill for IMA personal note management via OpenAPI.
- Supports note searching, notebook browsing, content retrieval, note creation, and appending content.
- Triggers automatically for user intents related to personal notes, memos, or document storage, even if not explicitly mentioned.
- Includes detailed setup instructions, API call templates, and usage workflows.
- Highlights privacy rules: in group chats only show note titles and summaries, never full content.
- Provides comprehensive guides on encoding handling, pagination, error codes, and API field mappings.
